bringCaregiver.title: Bring your own caregiver
bringCaregiver.subtitle: Already have a caregiver, or about to hire one? We make sure everything is in order.
bringCaregiver.intro: The "Bring your own caregiver" service is designed for people who already have a caregiver at home, or who are about to hire one on their own, and would like the advice of an expert company.

has.title: You already have a caregiver at home
has.text: We regularise the contract and take care of the legal procedures so everything is in order.

hiring.title: You are about to hire one on your own
hiring.text: We advise you from the start, with every legal aspect taken into account.

legal.title: Legal aspects covered
legal.text: We take into account every legal aspect of the hiring process.

contract.title: Contract regularisation
contract.text: We formalise your caregiver's contract so everything is above board.

procedures.title: Legal procedures
procedures.text: We handle the paperwork so you don't have to.

support.title: Expert advice
support.text: You have the backing of a company specialised in elderly care.

support.title: Peace of mind and support
support.text: With "Bring your own caregiver" you have the support and follow-up of social and healthcare professionals and specialists.

cta.title: Want to regularise your caregiver?
cta.text: Tell us about your situation and we will advise you with no obligation.
